Priya M: Morning — small but odd drop in MQL->SQL conversion for webinar cohort (Mar 10-12). Dashboard spike in cost per MQL. Snapshot: https://redwood.app/dash/123 :eyes:
Lena (Analytics): I saw that too. Looks like attribution window shifted from 30d->7d for that new GA4 property last night. Could be sample-rate mismatch.
Sam G: hmm — GA4 change was rolled last deploy. @Lena could you paste quick query for cohort counts?
Lena (Analytics): ```sql
SELECT cohort, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(is_sql) AS sql_count
FROM marketing.leads
WHERE utm_campaign='webinar-march'
GROUP BY cohort;
```
Lena (Analytics): ran it — total 1,120 vs 4,230 previous week. sql_count down 68%.
Jorge - Sales Ops: FYI sales routing tweak yesterday bumped high-intent leads to queue-B; I didn't think it would affect metrics but maybe duplicates/new lead dedup is filtering differently.
Tom - Growth: can we confirm sample-rate and dedupe logic? If GA4 is 7d, attribution windows mismatch will move conversions away.
Priya M: ok action: Sam annotate dashboard with deploy and GA4 window; Lena confirm raw counts and attach CSV; Jorge validate SF dedupe rules; Tom run messaging cohort A/B check.
Sam G: I'll add annotation and kick off a small dashboard refresh (cache clear + re-aggregation). ETA 30m.
dashbot: [ANOMALY] Dashboard 'launch-performance' alerted: conversion_drop > 35% vs baseline (automated)
Lena (Analytics): attached raw CSV https://files.redwood/webinar-cohort-march.csv
Jorge - Sales Ops: confirmed dedupe rule changed on 1793334200 — rolling back to previous rule now.
Priya M: cool — let's meet 11:15 for 15m if numbers aren't stable. Thanks :thumbsup:
